en.title_tag: LG Washing Machine Error LE: Meaning and Safe Steps
en.meta_description: LG washer showing LE? Read the verified meaning, safe manual-based checks and when authorised service is required.
en.h1: What Does LE Mean on an LG Washing Machine?
en.description: The tub failed to spin because the motor could not operate normally.
en.quick_fix: Unplug for 5 minutes, reduce an overloaded wash and remove only clearly visible loose objects without reaching into mechanisms (about 5–30 minutes).
en.intro_html:
The tub failed to spin because the motor could not operate normally.

Unplug for 5 minutes, reduce an overloaded wash and remove only clearly visible loose objects without reaching into mechanisms. Do not order a part from the code alone, dismantle the washer or measure internal components.

This is a possible cause; the exact model manual and professional diagnosis determine an internal fault.

causes_json.cause: Internal motor, sensor or drive fault
causes_json.detail: This is a possible cause; the exact model manual and professional diagnosis determine an internal fault.

steps_json.detail: Cancel the programme, wait for the drum to stop and do not force the door.
Disconnect with dry hands. Do not handle filter water until it has cooled.
Unplug for 5 minutes, reduce an overloaded wash and remove only clearly visible loose objects without reaching into mechanisms.
Make at most one restart after correcting an external cause and only without leakage, smell, heat, smoke or electrical damage.
Unplug and request authorised service if LE returns. Use an electrician if the outlet or fixed supply is suspect.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
Arrange authorised LG service if LE remains or returns. PE, PS and tE concern systems users must not test; LE and OE require service when external checks do not resolve the fault.

Unplug immediately for leakage near electricity, burning smell, smoke, sparks, abnormal heat or tripped protection.
en.prevention_html:
Follow load limits, empty pockets, dose correctly, keep external hoses free of kinks and clean the user-accessible filter as the model manual specifies.

Connect the washer as installed without an unsuitable power strip; internal sensor, motor and electronics faults cannot be prevented through dismantling.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using a Bosch washer showing LE?
faq_json.answer: Unplug for 5 minutes, reduce an overloaded wash and remove only clearly visible loose objects without reaching into mechanisms. Do not run another cycle until Bosch guidance or service confirms it is safe.

faq_json.question: Can I reset LE by switching the washer off?
faq_json.answer: Switching off is a safety step, not proof that the fault is repaired. If the code returns or Bosch classifies it as service-only, do not repeatedly reset the washer.

faq_json.question: Does LE identify a part to replace?
faq_json.answer: No. The code identifies a system or condition, but Bosch service should diagnose the exact cause before any part is ordered.

faq_json.question: Why should I provide the E-Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch model families and markets can use different hardware and service procedures. The E-Nr identifies the correct appliance documentation.

faq_json.question: May I test the sensor myself?
faq_json.answer: No. Do not remove panels or measure internal wiring, sensors or electronics. Bosch directs these codes to customer service.

en.h1: What Does tE Mean on an LG Washing Machine?
en.description: The washer detected a temperature-sensor or heating error.
en.quick_fix: Unplug for 10 seconds once and restart; close the water taps, unplug and request service if tE returns (about 5–30 minutes).
en.intro_html:
The washer detected a temperature-sensor or heating error.

Unplug for 10 seconds once and restart; close the water taps, unplug and request service if tE returns. Do not order a part from the code alone, dismantle the washer or measure internal components.

steps_json.detail: Cancel the programme, wait for the drum to stop and do not force the door.
Disconnect with dry hands. Do not handle filter water until it has cooled.
Unplug for 10 seconds once and restart; close the water taps, unplug and request service if tE returns.
Make at most one restart after correcting an external cause and only without leakage, smell, heat, smoke or electrical damage.
Unplug and request authorised service if tE returns. Use an electrician if the outlet or fixed supply is suspect.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
Arrange authorised LG service if tE remains or returns. PE, PS and tE concern systems users must not test; LE and OE require service when external checks do not resolve the fault.

Unplug immediately for leakage near electricity, burning smell, smoke, sparks, abnormal heat or tripped protection.
en.prevention_html:
Follow load limits, empty pockets, dose correctly, keep external hoses free of kinks and clean the user-accessible filter as the model manual specifies.

Connect the washer as installed without an unsuitable power strip; internal sensor, motor and electronics faults cannot be prevented through dismantling.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using a Bosch washer showing tE?
faq_json.answer: Unplug for 10 seconds once and restart; close the water taps, unplug and request service if tE returns. Do not run another cycle until Bosch guidance or service confirms it is safe.

faq_json.question: Can I reset tE by switching the washer off?
faq_json.answer: Switching off is a safety step, not proof that the fault is repaired. If the code returns or Bosch classifies it as service-only, do not repeatedly reset the washer.

faq_json.question: Does tE identify a part to replace?
faq_json.answer: No. The code identifies a system or condition, but Bosch service should diagnose the exact cause before any part is ordered.

faq_json.question: Why should I provide the E-Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch model families and markets can use different hardware and service procedures. The E-Nr identifies the correct appliance documentation.

faq_json.question: May I test the sensor myself?
faq_json.answer: No. Do not remove panels or measure internal wiring, sensors or electronics. Bosch directs these codes to customer service.
